image_description: A close-up product shot of a statement necklace featuring large, dark blue, polished oval beads arranged in a cascading fan shape. The beads are strung on a fine silver-tone chain that loops upward toward a blurred background object resembling a piece of driftwood or stone. The background is a solid, bright cyan color.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The surface texture of the blue beads is extremely uniform and plastic-like, lacking the microscopic imperfections or natural inclusions expected in real stone or high-quality glass. Highlights are slightly smeared.

The precise mechanical connection between the fine chain links and the drilled holes in the blue beads is ambiguous. The links appear to merge slightly into the bead surface rather than passing cleanly through a hole, suggesting minor fusion artifacts common in AI generation.

The background object has a slightly soft, melted appearance with inconsistent grain direction, typical of AI-generated background elements intended to provide depth but lacking rigorous geometric structure.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a necklace and distinguish between materials (metal vs. plastic vs. stone).
To verify the physical connectivity between the chain links and the beads, ensuring no floating parts or impossible fusions exist.
To assess the realism of the reflections on the metal and beads, and detect subtle texture inconsistencies or AI-smoothing artifacts.
To ensure the necklace sits correctly in front of the background prop without erroneous bleeding or depth map conflicts.

focus_areas: Connectivity integrity between chain links and bead holes
Realism of specular highlights on metal vs. stone surfaces
Structural plausibility of the bead arrangement (gravity/tension)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'fusion' severity at the connection points. AI often struggles to render small rings passing through small holes, resulting in visual merging. Also, evaluate if the 'plastic' look of the beads is a stylistic choice or a generation artifact.
